rules: AGENTS.md and docs/agent-workflow.md require executable inward dependency/effect contracts, negative tests and static runtime target validation; existing pyproject import contracts remain authoritative.

modules.responsibility: Static validation of runtime target paths, initialization effects and inner-layer effect ownership.
modules.interface: ASTs and source trees produce findings without executing inspected code; resolve scoped names and supported explicit re-exports conservatively.
modules.effects: Reads inspected source files only; never executes inspected definitions or effects.

modules.responsibility: Prove real architecture passes and prohibited source patterns fail.
modules.interface: Temporary source fixtures and existing graph checks establish negative and positive cases.
modules.effects: Owns temporary test fixture files; existing smoke subprocess is retained.

modules.responsibility: Keep static architecture tooling independent of inspected application modules and extra SDKs.
modules.interface: Source text produces import allowlist findings; actual imports pass and injected runtime imports fail.
allowed_dependencies: existing pytest and packaging test dependencies
modules.effects: Reads the checker source; does not import or execute inspected application code.

contracts.rules: Real source and generated targets pass; missing targets and direct inner effects fail; scoped shadowing and lazy definitions remain allowed.
Architecture helper imports only Python standard library and grimp; injected runtime/SDK/relative imports fail.

checks.expectation: Actual architecture and all negative/positive fixtures pass.

checks.command: uv run --frozen --no-sync ruff check tests/architecture_helpers.py tests/test_architecture.py tests/test_tooling_boundaries.py && uv run --frozen --no-sync mypy tests/architecture_helpers.py tests/test_architecture.py tests/test_tooling_boundaries.py && uv run --frozen --no-sync vulture
checks.expectation: Changed tooling remains lint-clean and strictly typed.
Parent-integrated documentation checker validates records and guide changes.

documentation: Parent updates architecture guide with scoped effects, supported explicit re-exports and limitations; bug artifacts preserve dated reproduction and checks.

review.reconciliation: Fresh independent read-only review of the integrated task-owned runtime/tooling/tests/docs and architecture scope after parent verification. All initial findings corrected and re-reviewed; actual added/modified paths covered, no moved/deleted runtime modules. Original local uv.sources overrides and untracked grid-search draft excluded. Native/package runtime manifests still match all180files; final review records preserve limits.
